title: Restore Design App Selection Hook Registration
description: Fix the compose play runtime crash caused by a missing useDesignAppSelection symbol in compose/sketchpad/index.tsx. Restore the design selection hook implementation, extend existing tests to cover it, verify with targeted tests/build, and close the ticket with the touched files.
summary: Restored the missing Design app selection hook and field in compose/sketchpad/index.tsx, which removes the useDesignAppSelection ReferenceError during compose play startup. Extended the existing in-file Design Playwright regression to fail explicitly if that startup error reappears. Verified with direct package-local Vite builds for @semio-tech/compose-sketchpad and @semio-tech/compose-sketchpad-play.
